text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hawa, you're amazing after all...! It's so 
detailed and fast, um...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, just go ask him! It's a 
golden opportunity, isn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So, I was told that pitch would suit me 
better than stride... and I was hoping you 
could teach me, Chan-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You want to learn the pitch running style 
from Chan. That spirit is admirable. Let's 
get started right away.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why here? This is a shrine, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The long stone steps of the shrine are 
perfect for honing the Chan-chan running 
technique.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Though I'm just parroting what my 
Trainer said.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: I'm not losing my edge anymore!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so? Fufu... I'm glad...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"To think the Mar-chan Running Style still 
had room for refinement..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, this is, well... It's going to be 
burned into my memory even more now...
choice_data_list:
Let's show them a run they'll never 
forget!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Truth be told, it's a secret special 
training session, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is honing an 'unforgettable run' 
together with Trainer, after all."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The two of you with such keen eyes shall 
serve as living witnesses...!
